name: Alpinarium
kurzbeschreibung: A unique **climbing and cultural hub in Imst**, featuring a **climbing gym**, **bouldering area**, **museum**, and **event spaces**.
beschreibung: The **Alpinarium** in **Imst** is a walkable rock monument and information center dedicated to the **alpine history of the region**. Located at the entrance to **Imst**, it blends architecture with the surrounding rock formations. The building documents the evolution of nature, mountain farming, and tourism in the **Gurgltal** valley. Visitors can explore a **multimedia permanent exhibition** on the formation of the Alps and life in the mountains. The offer is complemented by special exhibitions on contemporary topics from culture and science. The structure itself is built from local materials and harmonizes with the rocky landscape.
